desc: For each student with at least one score, compute the median score: sort the scores ascending; with an odd count take the middle one, with an even count take the average of the two middle ones (as a Float, e.g. 2.5). Students with no scores are left out. Return (name, median) pairs ordered by median (highest first), then by name in ascending code-point order.

decls.ts: type Student = { name: string; scores: number[] };
